definitions.gloss: desire for career advancement; ambition (for success); drive to get ahead
definitions.explanation: A strong personal desire to rise in rank, status, or position — especially at a company or in society. Has a mildly negative or neutral nuance; "ambition" in a pure, positive sense is more often expressed with {向上心|こうじょうしん}.

examples.japanese: {出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: To have a strong desire for success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧らしい。
examples.english: He apparently doesn't have much desire to climb the career ladder.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いうち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{燃|も}えていた→燃える：02312_moeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young I burned with ambition, but now I value time with my family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that compared to the past, today's young employees have weaker ambitions for advancement.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧ (rising in the world, career success) and ⟦{欲|よく}→欲：13183_yoku⟧ (desire, drive). Refers to the desire to rise through the ranks of a company or of society — to get promoted, gain status, and earn a higher position.

REGISTER & NUANCE:
The word can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context. Someone described as having strong {出世欲|しゅっせよく} may be admired for their drive, but can also be seen as overly competitive or self-interested. For a more consistently positive term meaning general self-improvement ambition, use ⟦{向上心|こうじょうしん}→向上心：11897_koujoushin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have strong ambition
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no ambition for advancement
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧: to burn with ambition
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塊|かたまり}→塊：03905_katamari⟧: a mass of ambition (a very ambitious person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向上心|こうじょうしん}→向上心：11897_koujoushin⟧: desire for self-improvement — always positive; broader than career ambition
- ⟦{野心|やしん}→野心：15757_yashin⟧: ambition (often bold or ruthless) — a stronger word; may suggest scheming
- {功名心|こうみょうしん}: desire for fame or achievement — emphasizes wanting to be recognized
- {上昇志向|じょうしょうしこう}: upward-striving orientation — a more analytical, sociological term for the same drive
